record.body:
## Orientation

Parallel tasks in this wave edit disjoint files. Stay inside your task scope. Install node_modules in your worktree with `npm ci` in `dashboard/web/ui` when you need npm. Do not push.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/ui-structure`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run the launch tests, then every other phase check.

## Approach

Run each acceptance with `orchestra check` in the phase worktree. Do not edit the tree. Run the launch tests first.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: The UI lives in `dashboard/frontend`, and `dashboard/web` does not exist.
R2: The server serves `dashboard/frontend/dist`.
R3: `App.svelte` has fewer than 150 lines.
R4: Polling, journal, and overlay state live in `.svelte.ts` modules under `src/lib`.
R5: Home, Journal, Overlay, and Side rail are separate components under `src/lib`.
R6: `components.json` exists and its aliases point at `$lib`.
R7: The `$lib` alias resolves in `vite.config.ts` and in the tsconfig.
R8: The phase and task overlay tabs and dialogs use shadcn-svelte components.
R9: The global CSS defines the shadcn theme variables.
R10: `npm run lint` passes with the shadcn components present.
R11: `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
R12: Every existing deep link still resolves to the same screen.

### Design / decisions (quote)

- All routes and deep links resolve as before.
- The Vitest suite passes without edits to router and link tests.

- The shadcn `init` can run non-interactively with the aliases set by flags.
- Vite resolves `$lib` through an alias in `vite.config.ts`.

- `app-split`: Screens plus .svelte.ts state modules

- `shadcn-appearance`: Adopt the shadcn default look

- `shadcn-svelte`: shadcn-svelte

- `backend-frontend-split`: dashboard/backend and dashboard/frontend

### Frozen oracle (do not edit)

Files in acceptance oracle_hashes are frozen. Do not edit them:
- ['tests/dashboard/test_ui_structure.py']
An oracle hash or test-id change is a signed amendment in `.tuner/manifest.json`. orchestra verify verdict accepts or rejects it. A non-zero exit means the acceptance is not done.
